metadata.description: Configurable screening thresholds for trading activity, open interest, and contract maturity.
metadata.methodology_notes: Thresholds are derived from empirical distribution analysis of MCX gold contracts (2024-01-01 to 2026-10-22). Per-symbol thresholds account for structural contract size variations (1g micro to 1kg standard).

GOLD.rationale: 1 lot = 1kg (~₹70L notional). Traded P10=4 lots, P25=41 lots, Median=717 lots. 10 lots represents ₹7 Cr daily turnover.

GOLDM.rationale: 1 lot = 100g (~₹7L notional). Traded P10=160 lots, P25=681 lots, Median=4,292 lots. High liquidity.

GOLDGUINEA.rationale: 1 lot = 8g (~₹56k notional). Traded P10=26 lots, P25=169 lots, Median=932 lots.

GOLDPETAL.rationale: 1 lot = 1g (~₹7k notional). Micro contract with massive lot volume (Traded P10=555, P25=2880, Median=12811).

GOLDTEN.rationale: 1 lot = 10g (~₹70k notional). Launched March 2025. Traded P10=152 lots, P25=620 lots, Median=3048 lots.
